class.name: PS3Pad
class.brief_description: PS3 controller helper for pressure, sticks, and rumble.
class.description: Provides direct access to PSL1GHT pad features on PlayStation 3 builds. Uses the shared platform pad layer also consumed by the engine Input singleton.

method.name: get_left_stick
method.description: Returns the left analog stick as a normalized vector.

method.name: get_pressure
method.description: Returns button pressure for the given pad button index.

method.name: get_right_stick
method.description: Returns the right analog stick as a normalized vector.

method.name: is_connected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a controller is connected on the configured port.

method.name: set_rumble
method.description: Sets weak and strong motor rumble intensities from 0.0 to 1.0.
